name: Wild Geese Formation Canon (Nhạn Trận Kinh)
concept: A method for a file, not for one person. Each disciple learns to pass qi down the line the way geese trade the lead in a long flight: the one at the point takes the wind, and when the point tires it falls back and the next takes it. The canon cultivates no element. It trains the meridians to give and take a share of a neighbour's strain, so a file of five fights as one body with five pairs of hands. Singly, a disciple of the gate is ordinary. In file they are very hard to break, and they get stronger the longer the line holds.
lore: Written down by the founder Thạch Liệt Hàng from nine years of drill under Lạc Hà's Cảnh Trường Thiên (806-815, V096), and named for Nhạn Thanh Thành, where the geese cross the walls in formation (C092).

name: Drum of the Spring Levy (Xuân Điểm Cổ Pháp)
concept: The drum the gate beats when it drills the plain's mortal levies on the shore of Lạc Nhạn Hồ each spring. The drummer's qi goes into the beat, and the beat goes into the feet of everyone who hears it in time: a line of farmers keeps its spacing under arrows, and a file of disciples moves at one pace. In a fight the drum sets the file's rhythm and closes gaps when someone falls.
lore: The levy drum was first beaten in 807. Lạc Hà's Thảo Đường Thành and Nhạn Thanh Thành pay the gate for every spring it drills their farmers.

name: Walking Out of the Grey (Xuất Hôi Đoạn Hậu Pháp)
concept: The founders' art, made on one night. On Chiết Kích Nguyên in 803 Thạch Liệt Hàng's file of forty was inside the grey when it rose. They held their line, breathed through one wet cloth passed down the file, one breath each, and walked out backwards with the rear guard facing the halberds. The art teaches that: a file that shares its breath shares its poison, and a shared poison is a halved poison. In a fight it spreads curses, poisons and stacks laid on one member across the whole file, so no one carries enough to fall, and it lets the file give ground without breaking.
lore: Never written down until Thạch's death in 1040. It is taught only to the head and the elders. Mục Tân Vũ, the point of the first file, has not been taught it, and she is learning it anyway from Thạch's notes.
